              In this class, "Environmental innovation" means innovation for creation of a sustainable society. Learnig objective of this class is getting a method to think about SDGs management by learning about global issues in the world and domestic issues.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In 2016, the United Nations have started SDGs activities. In these activities, we expect involvement with private sector. A lot of companies are interesetd in SDGs business and it has a power to slove global and local social/enviromental issues and management issue for these companies.
In this class, students can learn various global and local issues as SDGs issues. There are a movie session with TED, a lecture session with e-learning and , a group exercise session in this class.
